newsitem.title: UK: Major has routine audience with Queen on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Major has routine audience with Queen on Tuesday.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major will have a routine audience with Queen Elizabeth on Tuesday, officials from Major's Downing Street office said on Monday.
The officials said they were confirming the meeting because it had inadvertently been omitted earlier from a list of Major's activities for the next few days.
Major has regular audiences with the Queen, usually weekly if they are both in London, to discuss affairs of state. The government never comments on the discussions.
Major has until Wednesday to announce an April 10 election.
But Major has made it clear his preferred date for the election is May 1, which coincides with local elections.
